features.title: AI Chat — Workbench / Sidebar / Search
features.description:
One conversational AI feature, three render modes. Same Convex backend (threads + streaming + tool calls + RAG), pick the surface via prop:

  • workbench — Claude.ai / ChatGPT three-column page (default)
  • sidebar — collapsible copilot panel inside another CRUD app
  • search — single-question + answer + citations (Perplexity)

Use cases:
  – Customer-support chatbot embedded in your marketing site
  – Developer copilot in your PR/docs admin
  – Knowledge-base search over your blog + docs corpus
  – Internal AI assistant in your dashboard

What it ships: multi-provider (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Mistral / Ollama), multimodal (text + image + PDF + audio), typed tool calls with inline inspector, agent mode (plan→execute→reflect), branching threads, RAG citations, resumable streams, usage telemetry. Public surface = consumer chat; admin surface = persona, fallback, guardrails per-bot.
features.agentRecipe: Run `npx rr add ai-chat`. Pick `mode="workbench" | "sidebar" | "search"` on `<AIChat />` (or use the convenience exports `<AIChatWorkbench />`, `<AIChatSidebar />`, `<AIChatSearch />`). Same backend tables + streaming action for all three.

features.title: AI Studio — Generation Canvas
features.description:
AI is the primary UI — single big prompt input → live-streaming output → variation grid → version tree. Suno / Midjourney / Lovable / v0 pattern. Output kinds: text, code, image, audio (configurable per template).

Use cases:
  – AI image generation product (creative output)
  – AI logo / banner / social-post studio
  – AI code-snippet generator (component scaffolder)
  – AI music / voiceover producer
  – AI blog-draft factory (text)

Features: prompt history, branch + compare outputs, like + favorite, share-to-link, templates from ai-admin.
features.agentRecipe: Run `npx rr add ai-studio`. Mount `<GeneratorCanvas />` at /. Use case: prompt → output IS the entire product. Wire your output renderer (text/image/code/audio) via the OutputSlot adapter. Templates loaded from ai-admin.studio.templates.

features.title: AI Agents — Autonomous Workers
features.description:
Background AI workers. Define an agent (skill × model × tools × max-iter), trigger it on-demand or on a cron schedule, watch the step-by-step trace as it runs. Devin / Replit-Agent / Manus pattern.

Use cases:
  – Nightly audit-bp on the codebase (PR-reviewer style)
  – Weekly SEO crawl + content suggestions
  – Auto-moderate comment queue
  – Scheduled data ingestion + summarization
  – Long-form research task with multi-source citations

Features: queue + live trace, per-step retry policy, hard cost cap, shareable trace URLs, full audit-log integration.
features.agentRecipe: Run `npx rr add ai-agents`. Mount `<RunnerDashboard />` at /agents. Trigger runs via `runAgent({agentSlug, input, scheduleAt?})`. Cron scheduler via Convex cron — wire if you need scheduled runs. Agent definitions managed in ai-admin.

features.title: AI Admin — Console (Instructions · Skills · Tools · Agents · Providers)
features.description:
Central operator console for the whole AI stack. Every other ai-* feature reads its registries from here. Tabs ordered to match the build-flow:

  1. Providers   — register Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Mistral / Ollama (API keys AES-encrypted at rest)
  2. Models      — per-provider catalog (capabilities, context window, pricing)
  3. Instructions — custom system-prompt library (Claude Projects-style)
  4. Skills      — named instruction + model default + tool defaults (consumed by chat + studio)
  5. Tools       — JSON-schema function specs + impl (http / convex / shell) + sandbox flag
  6. Agents      — skill × model × tools × max-iter (consumed by ai-agents)
  7. Budgets     — per-workspace cost caps + alerts + hard kill
  8. Audit       — every AI call: actor / agent / tokens / cost / latency / outcome

Includes Create-Agent / Create-Skill / Create-Tool / Create-Instruction wizards.
features.agentRecipe: Run `npx rr add ai-admin`. Adds an `AI` section to the admin-panel ADMIN_SECTIONS registry. Sub-tabs ordered to match build-flow: Providers → Models → Instructions → Skills → Tools → Agents → Budgets → Audit. Includes Create-* wizards for instructions / skills / tools / agents. API keys AES-encrypted via AI_ADMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY env. The instruction / skill / tool / agent registries are SSOTs consumed by every ai-* consumer slice (chat + studio + agents).

features.title: AI Router — Backend Provider Proxy
features.description:
Backend infrastructure (no UI). Single proxy that every other ai-* feature calls. Tier-routed — nano (Haiku) for classification, mid (Sonnet) for chat, flagship (Opus) for deep reasoning. Per-call usage log + cost guard. Works with direct provider keys or OpenRouter umbrella.

Not something you mount — installed automatically as a peer when you add ai-chat / ai-studio / ai-agents.
features.agentRecipe: Run `npx rr add ai-router`. Wrap every AI call through ai-router. Tiers: nano = quick classification (spam-flag, headline-suggest), mid = chat / draft, flagship = methodology-review / deep-think. Token usage logs to ai_usage table for the cost dashboard.

features.title: Responsive Dialog (Sheet ↔ Modal)
features.description: ResponsiveDialog — auto-switches between bottom Sheet (mobile) and centered Dialog (desktop) at the md breakpoint. Same API as shadcn Dialog. Kitab forbids raw <dialog>; use this everywhere. Facade slice — pulls from template-base/frontend/slices/responsive-dialog.
